_doc: Achievements (design/lives/lives-and-carryover-spec.md §7; build items N-1.2 frame, N-7.7 the list). Deeds the soul remembers: never raw power. Each has a kind (region, school, life, craft, story, challenge), a name, a hint (shown for hidden ones as '?'), when (a story condition, checked through the day and as a life ends: ended(cause) and omens() are true only then and this life), and grants (N-7.7): title (worn on the Deeds tab; people's reactions come later), sigil (a cosmetic mark on the spellbook, from sigils), codex (a page in the Codex, from pages), knowledge (Ledger ids learnt) and cache (from caches: from then on you remember where the world's own item lies; mark up to `marks` a life while it is moon `mark_moon`, and its map item is there to open). A road's opens_by may name an achievement id. hidden: shows as '?' with its hint until earned. sealed: a story achievement, shown only as 'A deed not yet done' (SEALED, written by the story threads).

eclipse.name: To the Last Day
eclipse.hint: See a year through to the Eclipse.

omen.name: Under a Bad Sky
omen.hint: Finish a year under an Omen.

field_notes.name: Field Notes
field_notes.hint: Find the weakness of five kinds of foe (the Field Guide).

old_hand.name: Old Hand
old_hand.hint: Master three kinds of foe in the Field Guide.

seven_doors.name: Seven Doors
seven_doors.hint: Know what every stroke is for.

patient_way.name: Bread for Highsun
patient_way.hint: Save the seed without a fire.

the_coupling.name: The Coupling
the_coupling.hint: Keep the light where it belongs.

rule_one.name: Rule One
rule_one.hint: Pack your first device at the bench.

in_the_black.name: In the Black
in_the_black.hint: Turn a handsome profit on exam day.

top_of_the_slate.name: Top of the Slate
top_of_the_slate.hint: Hold the top rung of the camp ladder.

wrayburn.name: The Kiln-master's Pupil
wrayburn.hint: Finish what was left in the Kiln.

market_stood.name: The Market Stood
market_stood.hint: Hold the Market through the night.

roof_down.name: Down Comes the Roof
roof_down.hint: Bring a building down with magic.

every_job.name: Every Job on the Board
every_job.hint: Finish all eight commissions in one year.

card_sharp.name: Nobody Left to Beat
card_sharp.hint: Beat all six players at the camp's tables.

first_ring.title: The First Ring
first_ring.text: The yard trial, the first year you passed it. The sand was cold, the crowd was small and nobody cheered, and that was fine. You walked off the sand a Ring higher than you walked on.

last_day.title: The Last Day
last_day.text: You saw the sun go out once, all the way. The whole camp stood and looked up. You remember that it was quiet, and that it was cold, and then nothing, and then morning.

the_slate.title: Top of the Slate
the_slate.text: Your name in chalk at the top of the ladder slate, with nobody above it. Somebody rubbed it out the next year. Somebody always does.

masters_hand.title: A Master's Hand
masters_hand.text: There was a day a spell stopped being a thing you did and became a thing you were. You can't find that day again, but your hands remember it.

walking_wounded.title: Walking Wounded
walking_wounded.text: You went out to meet the night with your ribs strapped and a limp you couldn't hide. You don't remember being brave. You remember being stubborn.

refectory_satchel.name: A tinker's satchel
refectory_satchel.where: Behind the refectory hearth, in the College halls.

trapper_cache.name: A trapper's kit
trapper_cache.where: Under a flat stone by the Mill lane.

market_strongbox.name: The market strongbox
market_strongbox.where: Under the loose boards by the market's great lamp.
